title: Honda clinches 12th IndyCar manufacturers’ crown
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Before Alex Palou wrapped up the drivers’ title, Honda captured its 12th IndyCar Series manufacturers’ championship on Sunday at the Milwaukee Mile, with two races left to run.

title: Palou clinches fourth consecutive, fifth overall IndyCar title in Milwaukee
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Alex Palou entered Milwaukee as "Quattro," IndyCar’s reigning four-time champion with a remarkable streak of three titles in a row, and left as "Cinco," the newest five-time champ with a streak that now extends to four consecutive crowns and five in a span of six years.

title: O’Ward makes it a Sunday sweep with IndyCar Race 1 win at Milwaukee
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: The Arrow McLaren driver made two visits to victory lane Sunday, winning both races in IndyCar's doubleheader at the Milwaukee Mile as Alex Palou secured his fifth championship title.

title: Lundgaard scores timely oval breakthrough with Milwaukee podium
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Christian Lundgaard’s most impressive oval performance was delivered last year at the Milwaukee Mile, where he wheeled the No. 7 Chevy to sixth, and with another year of experience to draw from, the outgoing Arrow McLaren driver set a new career best with third in Sunday’s Race 2.

title: Fifth place at Milwaukee has Palou on the cusp of a fifth title
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: While it wasn’t enough to clinch his fifth IndyCar Series championship, he did extend the lead to a nearly insurmountable 97 points over Kyle Kirkwood, who finished sixth.

title: O’Ward blasts to victory in the first of IndyCar’s two Milwaukee races to finish
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Pato O’Ward started second and finished first in Sunday’s Snap-On Race 2 at the Milwaukee Mile, which was actually the first to be completed after the conclusion of Saturday's Race 1 was postponed until this evening.

title: Milwaukee IndyCar Race 1 postponed again to 6pm ET
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Overnight rain and thunderstorms have undone the IndyCar Series’ plans to resume Saturday’s Snap-On Race 1 at the Milwaukee Mile this morning. Rain is expected to continue for a brief period before finishing for the day.

title: IndyCar's Race 1 at Milwaukee postponed, set to resume Sunday
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Due to inclement weather and difficulties drying the track, the red-flagged race was unable to continue Saturday night and has been postponed to 8 a.m. CT/9 a.m. ET on Sunday.

title: O’Ward leads IndyCar Race 1 in Milwaukee at red flag
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Light but persistent showers brought an halt to Saturday’s IndyCar Series race at the Milwaukee Mile, now set to resume Sunday morning.

title: McLaughlin, Palou split Milwaukee IndyCar poles, but only one will start from the front
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Engine penalties for Saturday's race move Arrow McLaren's Pato O'Ward from fourth to first in the starting line-up.
